result:
The api died because the disk filled up: the `report-export` job wrote about 20 GB of CSVs to `/var/lib/stockroom` in eight minutes, Postgres ran out of space, and the api exited and never came back.

One thing to check first: every line in `logs/service.log` is dated 2026-03-09, and today is 2026-10-08. If the outage you mean was last night, this is not the log for it.

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:00–03:05 | Normal traffic, all requests 200. |
| 03:05:00 | `report-export` starts writing a 512 MB CSV to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` every 12 seconds. |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%` |
| 03:12:48 | Last export file written (41 files in total). |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%` |
| 03:13:51 | Last successful api request. |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool` |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` |
| 03:16–05:28 | `proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes, 67 times, until the log ends at 05:29:57. |

- **No recovery:** there is not a single api line after 03:14:06, so the api was still down when the log ends, at least 2h15m later. The compose file sets `restart: unless-stopped` on the api, yet the log shows no restart attempt; I can't tell why from the log alone.
- **Other services:** web and proxy kept serving 200s throughout; only requests routed to the api failed.
- **Alerting gap:** the 91% warning came five minutes before the crash, and nothing in the log shows anyone or anything acting on it.
- **Unrelated noise:** the 43 `cache: slow command` warnings run at a steady rate (roughly one every five minutes) across the whole log, before and after the crash.

The `report-export` job itself is not in this repo (nothing in `scripts/` or `app/` matches the name), so I couldn't see why it wrote that much. The durable fix is to get the exports off the database's volume or cap them; I haven't changed anything.

The ponytail plugin's statusline badge isn't configured; say so if you want me to add it to `settings.json`.
